'''The Queen's Blessing''' is an inn located in the city of [[Caemlyn]], capital of [[Andor]]. It is a fairly broad stone building with a large common room, a decent kitchen, several private rooms, an attached stable and even a small library.

In {{ne|998}} the innkeeper was [[Basel Gill]]. Other staff included the cook, several maids and a strongarm to guard the door, named [[Lamgwin Dorn]]. [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Mat Cauthon]] were directed to the Queen's Blessing by [[Thom Merrilin]], a friend of Gill's, and there were reunited with [[Perrin]], [[Egwene]], [[Moiraine]] and [[Lan]] here. It was also here where Rand al'Thor first met [[Loial]]. The Queen's Blessing was a meeting point for those who supported Queen [[Morgase]] during the tensions that plagued the city over the parading of [[Logain]] through the city.

After Rand's visit, the inn enjoyed peace for a time, until Morgase had to flee the city and [[Martyn Tallanvor]] enlisted Basel Gill and Lamgwin's aid in helping them escape.
